events.summary: Hi Folks,We released the demo for Cinderline. I cannot say how much these 7 months of development meant. Note: There is a current issue with the sliders. Click around the handle to adjust to your likings. For the longest time I had always wanted to create a game that is both strange, mysterious, and unique with characters that players can remember, draw, and connect with. events.title: Thank you for 2000 Wishlists!
events.summary: We passed 2000 Wishlists!We have been working so hard on the demo for these past few months. I cannot express my gratitude for how far the development of Cinderline has come. Me and my friend cannot wait to share the game's demo with you all in August. Our plan is release the demo mid to late August, giving us time to fix any bugs or concerns you may have, and even add new content before Steam Next Fest. It makes me so happy to see that 2000 of you genuinely find this game we are building worthy
